title: Computation Note: Percentage Discount Amounts Under the Patient Hardship Discount Program
content:
**Computation note — Patient Hardship Discount Program.** The discount on an eligible charge is the level's discount percentage of the charge's open amount, rounded to the cent.

### Percentages by level

| Level | Discount percentage of the open amount |
|---|---|
| Hardship Discount Level 1 (25%) | 25% |
| Hardship Discount Level 2 (50%) | 50% |
| Hardship Discount Level 3 (75%) | 75% |
| Hardship Discount Level 4 (100%) | 100% |
| Presumptive Eligibility Discount | 100% |
| Catastrophic Medical Hardship | 0% — the discount at this level is the catastrophic cap amount, not a percentage |

### Definition in parts

- **Base:** the charge's open amount.
- **Rate:** the discount percentage of the determination's level.
- **Amount:** the open amount multiplied by the percentage and divided by 100.
- **Rounding:** to the cent, on the amount for that one charge.

### Worked amounts (hypothetical charges)

| Level | Open amount of the charge | Open amount multiplied by the percentage, divided by 100 | Discount, rounded to the cent |
|---|---|---|---|
| Hardship Discount Level 1 (25%) | $43.17 | 10.7925 | $10.79 |
| Hardship Discount Level 2 (50%) | $87.36 | 43.68 | $43.68 |
| Hardship Discount Level 3 (75%) | $128.43 | 96.3225 | $96.32 |
| Hardship Discount Level 4 (100%) | $62.40 | 62.40 | $62.40 |

At a 100% level the discount equals the open amount, so nothing of that charge remains owed after the discount.
